nodes.rationale: So the quoted amount can be checked against the reviewed amount before paying.

nodes.label: CJ wallet balance as the hard spending ceiling
nodes.norm_label: cj wallet balance as the hard spending ceiling
nodes.rationale: The checks are code, but the AI running them holds the CJ key; the wallet balance and the short list of allowed hosts are the real walls.

nodes.rationale: Leave out anything that needs a permit or invites trouble.

nodes.label: Rule 5: only locally stocked goods
nodes.rationale: An order that does not ship from and to the configured country is never paid without the owner's approval.

nodes.label: Cash-on-delivery refusal risk
nodes.rationale: CJ's order data does not show the payment method, so hold_above_idr is the only guard.

nodes.label: Indonesia USD 100 cross-border floor (local stock only)
nodes.norm_label: indonesia usd 100 cross-border floor (local stock only)
nodes.rationale: Goods shipped from outside Indonesia are not an option: USD 100 per-unit floor on cross-border marketplace sales, and TikTok penalises late dispatch.

nodes.label: Feasibility test before trusting the automation
nodes.norm_label: feasibility test before trusting the automation
nodes.rationale: The code cannot fix a supplier that cannot deliver, so CJ's Indonesian shop connection and on-time shipping are proven by hand first.

nodes.label: Growth path (faster scheduler, TikTok API adapter)
nodes.norm_label: growth path (faster scheduler, tiktok api adapter)
nodes.rationale: tick is the only entry point, so a faster schedule is a scheduler swap; TikTok's own API is the next module, not a rewrite.
